description: This file defines reusable UI widgets for a Flutter application, specifically a section header and a styled card component.

classes.name: SectionHeader
classes.description: A widget representing a section header with a title and optional trailing widget, styled with a gradient background and padding.

classes.name: OceanCard
classes.description: A customizable card widget with shadow, rounded corners, optional tap handling, and configurable padding and margin.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for each of the custom widgets, rendering them with styles and optional interaction.
